pages.text: In the Alloy Smelter, one Iron Ingot and one Copper Ingot make two Conductive Alloy Ingots for 3,200 FE. Run two batches for your first conduit craft.

pages.title: Binder Composite
pages.text: Smelt the composite in a furnace or blast furnace.
Save six binders and three Conductive Alloy Ingots for $(l:enderio:getting_started/first_energy_line)Energy Conduits$(/l).
